title: GitCredentialRequest

action.description: What git asked the helper: get a credential, or erase one it was refused, which the environment reports and verifies again, forgetting nothing.

slug.description: The slug git's configuration named the helper with, which the environment's answers name.

protocol.description: git's protocol attribute: the helper serves git's http transport alone.

host.description: git's host attribute: the host, with its port when the URL had one.

description: What the credential helper asks the environment: git's verb, its own slug, and git's protocol and host.
